:::{#def-hadamard-code}
#### Hadamard code

The **Hadamard code** sends a message $x \in \mathbb{F}_2^k$, for $k \ge 1$,
to the $2^k$ inner products

$$\langle x, a \rangle = x_1 a_1 + \cdots + x_k a_k \pmod 2,$$

one for each $a \in \mathbb{F}_2^k$, so its block length is $n = 2^k$.
@arora2009computational [chapter 11] call it the Walsh--Hadamard code.

:::
